Renewal & expansion summary: Renewal window Q2 2026. Customer wants to move from Hosted->Dedicated for predictable latency on batch report generation and to meet throughput for morning rounds. Also evaluating Redwood Optimize for cost regression and to reduce token spend on nightly summarization jobs. Long-term ask: deploy private control plane in APAC for new partner sites in Singapore/Japan.

Technical constraints/highlights:
- Average inference payload: 450 tokens, peak concurrent requests 1200 (across US day).
- Target p95 latency: < 180ms for clinical-chat; bulk summarization throughput goal 10k reports/hour off-peak.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention 7 years, APAC data residency for specific sites.
- POC results: Dedicated (4x GPU config) achieves ~80–140ms median for 512-token runs in our staging tests; Optimize reduced token usage by 22% on sample prompts.
